# NaviWealth

> Local-first Personal LifeOS. FinanceOS is always on; HealthOS, KnowledgeOS,
> and ExecutionOS are opt-in domains. Client direction is NSH/Rust; Flutter is
> frozen to bug fixes. Backend is Cloudflare Workers in Rust. Sync is v3
> row-state LWW. AI is device-only with
> user-owned LLM profiles; there is no backend AI relay.

## Essential Docs

- [Documentation Index](docs/index.md): Human and AI entry point for the docs tree.
- [Agent Guide](AGENTS.md): Build commands, architecture rules, and coding conventions for AI agents.
- [Architecture Northstar](docs/architecture/lifeos-architecture-northstar.md): Hard boundaries and non-goals.
- [LifeOS Shell](docs/architecture/lifeos-shell.md): Domain registration, routing, AI, memory, sync, persistence seams.
- [Device AI Architecture](docs/ai/ai-architecture.md): Device-only runtime design.
- [Agent Runtime Current Architecture](docs/architecture/agent-runtime-current.md): Current Rust runtime code map, invariants, and maintenance guide.
- [AI Runtime Event Contract](docs/ai/ai-protocol.md): Stream event and tool contract.
- [Sync v3 Protocol](docs/sync/sync-v3.md): Active row-state sync protocol.
- [Testing Strategy](docs/development/testing-strategy.md): Test pyramid, task spine, CI gate expectations.

## Current Code Roots

- `apps/nsh-client/`: New Rust/NSH UI client.
- `crates/health-core/`: Shared meal recognition and nutrition.
- `third_party/agent-runtime/`: Provider-neutral Rust runtime.
- Existing Dart roots below are frozen-client maintenance authorities.

- `apps/mobile/lib/app/domain_packs.dart`: Production domain inventory.
- `apps/mobile/lib/core/auth/domain_scope.dart`: Domain opt-in enum and wire values.
- `apps/mobile/lib/core/sync/domain_prefix.dart`: Sync row-family prefixes.
- `apps/mobile/lib/core/ai/`: AI contracts, runtime, agents, memory, composition.
- `apps/mobile/lib/features/`: Domain and finance feature code.
- `apps/backend/src/sync/`: Backend generic row-state sync store.

## Documentation Policy

Documentation describes the current implementation. Superseded protocols,
migration notes, and compatibility-only plans are removed rather than archived,
except the explicitly archived Finance roadmap and product-direction study
retained by the NSH migration decision.
